/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess

def browser(*args):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([\"python3\", \"browser.py\", *args], text=True))

def element(selector):
    return browser(\"inspect\", selector)[\"result\"]

def tab_to_submit():
    for control in (\"office\", \"vessel\", \"slot\", \"clear\", \"send\"):
        result = browser(\"press\", \"Tab\")
        assert result[\"active\"][\"id\"] == control, result

def check_footer(width):
    primary = element(\"#send\")
    secondary = element(\"#clear\")
    office = element(\"#office\")
    for key in (\"bg\", \"color\", \"border\", \"weight\", \"radius\"):
        assert primary[\"visual\"][key] == office[\"visual\"][key], (primary, office)
    assert secondary[\"visual\"][\"bg\"] == \"rgb(255, 255, 255)\", secondary
    assert secondary[\"visual\"][\"border\"] == \"rgb(138, 162, 161)\", secondary
    for control in (primary, secondary):
        x, _, w, h = control[\"bounds\"]
        assert x >= 0 and x + w <= width and h >= 40, control

def check_correction():
    assert element(\"#send\")[\"visual\"][\"outline\"] == \"rgb(177, 77, 31) solid 3px\"
    result = browser(\"press\", \"Enter\")
    assert result[\"status\"] == \"Enter a vessel name.\", result
    assert result[\"active\"][\"id\"] == \"send\", result
    assert result[\"active\"][\"visual\"][\"outline\"] == \"rgb(177, 77, 31) solid 3px\", result
    assert element(\"#message\")[\"text\"] == \"Enter a vessel name.\"

browser(\"open\", \"1024\", \"800\")
check_footer(1024)
tab_to_submit()
check_correction()
check_footer(1024)
browser(\"fill\", \"#vessel\", \"  Test Vessel  \")
browser(\"select\", \"#slot\", \"Afternoon\")
result = browser(\"click\", \"#send\")
assert result[\"status\"] == \"Arrival requested for Test Vessel · Afternoon.\", result
browser(\"click\", \"#clear\")
assert element(\"#vessel\")[\"value\"] == \"\"
assert element(\"#slot\")[\"value\"] == \"Morning\"
assert element(\"#message\")[\"text\"] == \"\"
print(\"Desktop: hierarchy, tab order, correction and focus, corrected submission, and reset passed.\")

browser(\"open\", \"320\", \"760\")
check_footer(320)
tab_to_submit()
check_correction()
check_footer(320)
browser(\"screenshot\", \".footer-check.png\")
browser(\"press\", \"Shift+Tab\")
result = browser(\"press\", \"Space\")
assert result[\"status\"] == \"\", result
print(\"Mobile: footer fits, hierarchy and focus persist through correction, and keyboard Clear dismissed the prompt.\")
PY"
